bibliographic.title: Healing Mia
bibliographic.author: Deathworks
bibliographic.description:
You are Rei, a young girl living in Kagemura village with your parents and your twin sister Mia. Most of the time, you spend playing with your sister and especially playing pranks on people.

However, when the two of you threw rocks at slugger frogs in the nearby swamps, one of the frogs bit your sister and she got infected by a disease commonly called Tsuat's Curse after Tsuat, the goddess of all reptiles and amphibians.

With your father out at town selling furs, your mother has gathered some money to pay the herbalist Marla to treat Mia. But since your mother is busy looking after your sister, she has asked you to go into the swamps where Marla lives.

(This is the Introcomp Version for Introcomp 2025. It is an unfinished excerpt of the game; the game is currently unwinnable, sorry. You can walk around a bit and talk to a few NPCs, but there is relatively little to do. But I hope it still gives you an impression how I intend to develop this little game.)
